visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing black-framed glasses and a light pink bow-tie blouse with a black pleated skirt, stands in front of a wooden bookshelf filled with books. She walks a few steps toward the camera while holding a red book titled 'A COURT OF THORNS AND ROSES'. The room is brightly and evenly lit. (2) She stops and holds up two books side-by-side: the red one and a green one titled 'A COURT OF MIST AND FURY'. She smiles broadly at the camera, displaying the book covers clearly. The background is a dense collection of books on wooden shelves. (3) She brings the two books up to her face, hiding her mouth and nose, looking directly into the camera with an expressive gaze. Her hands are seen holding the edges of the books. (4) The scene transitions to a graphic screen. On the left, three book covers are displayed vertically. On the right, a dark translucent box contains white text about fantasy novels and a lengthy personal message written in Traditional Chinese. Small icons and social media handles are visible at the bottom.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 英文小說分享 #1. [Slogan]: FANTASY NOVELS. (2) [Slogan]: 阿滴英文十週年了🥹 這支影片是2015年9月14號 上傳在阿滴英文頻道 「滴妹」的第一支影片 沒想到當初幫哥哥代班的影片 竟然是我成為創作者的重要契機 今天拍這個發現我真的老了 膠原蛋白不見了 青春也流逝了 唯一不變的就是 你們一直都陪伴在身邊 然後我強迫比哥哥還受歡迎(?) 謝謝你們陪伴了我的十年青春 我愛你們 下一個十年也請多多指教. [Logo]: @ 滴妹 的粉專.
